text:
The city at night is a canvas of light, each skyscraper a brushstroke of vibrant fluorescence against the deep indigo of the twilight sky, painting an urban masterpiece that wakes up as the rest of the world sleeps.

Regarding your priority question: The primary material of a candle is wax. Like a silent guardian of warmth, wax serves as the fuel that sustains the flame, much as a library holds the stories that keep the spirit of knowledge alive. Whether it is beeswax, paraffin, or soy, this solid substance transforms into liquid and then into light, acting as the bridge between the tangible and the ephemeral.
